## Activity

During August 2022, Market Eye Clinic recorded 36 captures. This represents the activity submitted for review during the month. Capture activity proceeded in the context of the clinic’s usual operational arrangements, with session lists running as planned apart from routine leave. No further variation in the scheduled activity is noted in the information provided.

The recorded activity provides the basis for the image-quality and grading results outlined below. These results should be read alongside the total number of captures for the month.

## Image quality

Of the 36 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 8.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading, and are reported separately from the images that produced a grading outcome. The result identifies the proportion of the month’s activity affected by image quality.

## Grading

There were 12 referable results during August 2022. The median lag for grading was 12. This is the median interval associated with the grading activity recorded for the month. Together, the referable results and median lag provide the reported overview of grading performance at Market Eye Clinic.
